# Vendored libraries

Both files are unmodified copies from three.js r160 (npm package `three@0.160.0`):

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `three.module.min.js` | `build/three.module.min.js` |
| `OrbitControls.js` | `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js` |

three.js, including its `examples/jsm` add-ons such as OrbitControls, is released under the MIT
license; `LICENSE` here is the three.js license text. MIT is compatible with this project's GPLv3.
